flag_descriptions.tensor_parallel_size=4: 1.06T-param Kimi-K2.6 INT4 (~530 GiB) only splits onto B300 at TP=4. Validated on the fat-fork B300 image.
flag_descriptions.gpu_memory_utilization=0.85: Leaves HBM headroom for the Kimi vision encoder on B300. Below the 0.92-0.95 used elsewhere; intentional for this model — info, not a regression.
flag_descriptions.max_num_batched_tokens=131072: One prefill chunk for batch=128 on B300's 275 GiB/GPU (B200 rev=2 had to drop to 32768 under cudagraph FULL on 178 GiB). Above the upstream 8192 chunked-prefill default — perf opt, no baseline violation; info.
flag_descriptions.compilation_mode=0: Eager (cudagraph NONE). Cudagraph hangs at batch=128 on Kimi MLA, and eager also saves ~5% throughput vs cudagraph FULL on this model. KIMI_INT4 base default; B200 rev=2 overrode to mode=3 for an experimental compiled tune — B300 stays eager.
flag_descriptions.attention_backend=CUTLASS_MLA: Required for Kimi-K2.6 MLA on TP=4. Pinned (also forced via the runner-patch) so the auto-selector can't regress it.
Server-side plugin flip — launches the composed gonka-poc entrypoint (PoC router + gating) instead of stock api_server. Required on the plugin base. No throughput trade-off; info.
